scripts.comment: 3.1.2.1-5: Solutions are shown on the page.
6. The outer REPEAT 3 means that we draw three blue triangles. Because of the inner REPEAT 3, each blue triangle does MOVE 50 STEPS three times. So the total is 3*3=9 blue lines.

9. (a) This is slightly tricky, because question 6 asked about blue /lines/ and this one is asking about blue /shapes/, i.e., squares. There are four blue squares. But if someone says 16, don't make this be a gotcha; it's a correct answer to a different question. (b) Try it! (c) This time the expected answer is 16.
Note that when you run this, for the first time you get new triangles /inside/ an old triangle (the red one). There's nothing super-significant to say about that, but it might be of some interest.

scripts.comment: SIZE > 9 as the base case test makes for pictures that students will understand easily. But have them try SIZE > 1 for more spectacular results. Hide the sprite and use turbo mode for fast drawing.

TIF A. The smaller shape is still attached at its corner to a corner of the larger shape, but it's inside rather than outside. (As a result, you can use a bigger size input. Start near the top left corner before running the demo below, which has SIZE > 3 in the base case test.)

It's those inner recursive shape blocks that are purple.
